April 02, 2023

This is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his / her / guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.








This E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.





I have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of " patient clinical data analysis" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.



 A 27 yr old male came to opd 

CHEIF COMPLAINTS : 

GIDDINESS SINCE 4 days 

Right upper and lower limb weakness since 4 days 

Slurring of speech since 4 days 

HOPI : 

Patient was apparently asymptomatic 4 days back and then while he was drinving tractor he had 2 episodes of giddiness and then following that he developed Right Upper And Lower Limb weakness, sudden in Onset ,Non Progressive,Unable to lift the hand Above the level of head. Deviation Of angle of mouth to Left side 

Slurring Of speech since 4 days 

No H/O of Trauma  falls.

No H/O Uprolling of Eyeball,involuntary Micturition, defecation 


PAST HISTORY 

Patient has Seizure Disorder since 20 yrs not on medication 

Last episode was 6 years ago 

Not a known case of :

DM,HTN, CAD,CVA,Asthma,TB, Epilepsy


Personal History : 

Diet -mixed 

Apetite -Normal 

Sleep -adequate 

Additiction : Alcohol comsumption -180ml daily 


FAMILY HISTORY : 

No similar complaints in the family  


Treatment history : 

No past surgeries have been done 

No known drug allergy 


GENERAL EXAMINATION : 







Pateineg is conscious coherent and cooperative 

No pallor

 No icterus, No cyanosis, No Clubbing, 

No  Lymphadenopathy,

No pedal edema 

Temp:- 96.8F

PR:-122bpm

RR:-18 cpm

BP:- 200/140 mmHg


SYSTEMIC EXAMINATION:

CVS :- S1s2+ heard 

RS:- NVBS( Non vesicular breath sounds ) 

PA :- Soft , NON TENDER 



CNS EXAMNINATION : 


HIGHER MOTOR FUNCTIONS - Intact 


NO SIGNS IF MENINGIAL IRRITATION 

( Brudzinski sign ,Kernigs sign ) 


CRANIAL NERVES : 

Normal 



SENSORY SYSTEM : 

Decreased Fine touch in Right Side below Knee



MOTOR SYSTEM : 

                   RT            LT 

Tone  UL  hypo       normal

           LL   hypo       normal 

    

Power           RT            LT 

            UL    3/5           5/5

            LL    4/5            5/5


Reflexes     RT     LT

B                  -         1+

T                  -         -

S                  -         -

K                  -         1+

A                  -         -


Investigations










Treatment : 

1.T. ECOSPIRIN PO STAT 

2.TAB.NICARDIA 10 MG PO STAT 

3.TAB. CLOPITAB PO STAT

4.TAB.ATORVAS PO STAT
